name: project-init
description: New-project setup and toolkit sync: project-init initializes a repo gate by gate, and project-sync audits an existing repo against the toolkit.

interface.shortDescription: Initialize or sync a project with Mike's toolkit.
interface.longDescription: Project setup and sync workflows from Mike Rihm's portable toolkit. Includes project-init for guided new-project setup and project-sync for auditing existing projects against the toolkit rules, hooks, memory, knowledge, and orientation conventions.
